documentOperations.notes: Gate values are regression tripwires measured on a 1,000-entity synthetic scene (best-of-N, dev hardware x2 headroom). The gate skips under -race, where the numbers measure race instrumentation rather than the code. The spec* fields record the product targets from spec section 19. Budgets were retightened on 2026-07-28 after the command bus dropped from three document clones and two fingerprints per transaction to one clone and one fingerprint for a direct commit, and one clone for a proposal: set-transform went 51.8ms to 22.4ms and undo 59.5ms to 27.1ms at 1,000 entities. The viewport pick then dropped from 2.8ms to 0.15ms once the workspace stopped re-deriving the fingerprint that keys the compiled-graph cache; workspacePickMs gates that path, exactPickMs still gates the package function that computes its own. Retighten again whenever a change moves these numbers, or the tripwires stop tripping. Still O(document): a direct commit clones the whole SceneDoc once and the journal writes a whole SceneDoc per record. Undo storing inverse operations, and the journal storing operations with periodic snapshots, are what remove that.
